programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoking Out a Killer
programme.desc: A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath used by students to walk from one side of campus to the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Wet
programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. Faced with striking similarities, examiners must determine if their suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Core Evidence
programme.desc: In 1996, more than a dozen children in Seattle, Washington, were fighting for their lives. Each one of them had contracted a serious unknown illness. After one died, investigators knew the clock was ticking.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Call
programme.desc: A murder investigation in Florida crosses jurisdictions from New York and Jamaica. The police rely on cell phone mapping, wiretapping and a host of forensic evidence to link a suspect to a murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wheel of Misfortune
programme.desc: Casino security cameras tracked a young woman's movements until shortly before she disappeared. She was never seen again, but through the evidence she left behind, she was able to tell investigators what happened to her and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pet Rock
programme.desc: In 1995, Palm Beach waitress Denise O'Neill is abducted and murdered. Her neighbor Luis Caballero arouses suspicions by behaving oddly towards TV crews covering the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The House That Roared
programme.desc: A woman disappears and her husband becomes the prime suspect — especially after police find a huge bloodstain on the carpet of their bedroom. When they spray the bedroom with Luminol, they discover it was awash with blood spatter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Desire
programme.desc: Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire which killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appears to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Hearted
programme.desc: When a young fireman died from what appeared to be serious but undiagnosed heart disease, his family and friends had no proof of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soft Touch
programme.desc: In 1992, 22-year-old Dawn Bruce is brutally murdered in her Virginia apartment. Investigators notice a blood smear on a pillow case that appears to have been made by one of the killer's fingers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pressed for Crime
programme.desc: Several suspects and conflicting evidence complicated a brutal murder investigation. But the forensics were clear on one thing: the killer knew his victim, and that alone gave investigators a head start.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Financial Downfall
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman falls to her death from a cliff overlooking the ocean. Initially, investigators think it was a tragic accident. But after a forensic examination, police uncover a very different picture of what happened.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Assets
programme.desc: In 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery was found brutally murdered at her Illinois business. Investigators had to determine if this was a robbery gone wrong or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: When an elderly couple died in a suspicious house fire, their son became the prime suspect. Investigators turned to forensic science to determine if the fire had been set deliberately, or if it was an unfortunate accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Letter Perfect
programme.desc: A healthy young man dies mysteriously in his sleep and toxicology tests reveal a lethal dose of lidocaine in his blood. Investigators find a suicide note and presume he killed himself until a forensic linguist examines the note.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dark Waters
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run boating accident caused the death of a popular young man, investigators faced the daunting task of searching for one boat among 1200 others.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Making the Collar
programme.desc: The body of 16-year-old Leanne Tiernan was discovered nine months after she disappeared. Forensic scientists found clues that painted a virtual portrait of her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Planted Evidence
programme.desc: One morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovers the body of a young woman. She had been beaten, bound, strangled and possibly raped. Nearby plants tell investigators more about the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Guarded Secrets
programme.desc: A security guard disappeared from his post without a trace; his remains were found a year later in a remote campsite.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: Who was the sexual offender who murdered two adolescent boys in Nebraska? The key to stopping him would be the unique composition of the "junk rope" he used to tie his victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Broken Promises
programme.desc: When a popular gym teacher is found dead of what appears to be an accidental gunshot wound, his family is suspicious. A tape recorded by the victim just before his death tells the true story of his strange marriage and his wife's insatiable greed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wood-be Killer
programme.desc: A killer tries to incinerate everything that could link him to his crime. But in doing so, he inadvertently creates new forensic evidence. Detectives employ a technique never before used in a criminal investigation to bring it to light.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Expert Witness
programme.desc: In 1993, young mother Tammy Tatum was sexually assaulted and murdered in her Longmont, Colorado apartment. Police initially suspected her estranged husband, but did not have enough evidence to charge him and the case went cold.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fatal Fungus
programme.desc: An infant is rushed to the emergency room with serious breathing problems. Within months, there are more than 30 similar cases. Can doctors find the cause and a cure?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muffled Cries
programme.desc: After inspecting storm damage to a home in Tampa, an insurance assessor simply disappeared. Thirty hours later, her body was found in a nearby river. But the killer had been careless.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cement the Case
programme.desc: In 1990, Shirley Andronowich's body was found mutilated. Eyewitnesses told police she had a fight with her husband the night before, but forensic evidence proved that he had nothing to do with her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair Line
programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a young scientist has fallen gravely ill. When tests finally reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Telltale Tracks
programme.desc: The disappearance of Philadelphia college athlete Aimee Willard is investigated after her car is found on the roadside. When her body is found, the police find unusual marks and DNA evidence that eventually lead to her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1990's Philadelphia became the scene of a bloody vendetta. The streets erupted in mob warfare. Authorities feared innocent people would be caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, cities across the United States became a battleground for vicious Croatian radicals. Their violent agenda targeted their own people living in America.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programme.desc: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970's South America faced a surge of political kidnappings and assassinations. When the killings spilled onto U.S. soil it was time for the FBI to step in.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980's the federal penitentiary in Atlanta held some of the country's most notorious prisoners. Castro called them undesirables. The U.S. government called them detainees. In 1987 they staged a bloody revolt.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Radical Agenda
programme.desc: In the 1970's a string of bank robberies and bombings spread fear and destruction along the east coast. The FBI faced a new breed of criminal, the domestic terrorist.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis: We've all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Compulsion
programme.desc: Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker: the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence
programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for investigators.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shreds of Evidence
programme.desc: Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Seeds of Destruction
programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Dosage
programme.desc: Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tools Of Death
programme.desc: Tool marking: A tool used to commit a crime can often be the same tool used to solve it. The pattern a machine leaves on an item, the unusual way a tool crimps a wire, and even something as innocuous as the shape of a wood chip can lead to a killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out Of The Grave
programme.desc: New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Infallible Witness
programme.desc: Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental "brain fingerprinting" technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.

programme.title: The New Detectives: From The Ashes
programme.desc: Arson Investigation: Insurance torchings, mob burnouts and arson murders: these crimes are designed to take all clues with them. But a solid case can be built from a heap of ashes.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.sub-title: The Space Race, The Hubble, Chasing Comets & Space Debris

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Stars Above

programme.title: The Apollo Experience: Apollo 17: Part 1
programme.desc: Between 1960 and 1972, mankind boldly went where no human had been before. Across 11 manned missions, 24 men flew to the moon and 12 walked upon its surface. This film documents Apollo 17 through the eyes of the astronauts who flew.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rays
programme.desc: Cosmic rays can tell us much about the universe. They are not simply another form of light, but carriers of information about powerful and unseen processes at work thousands or even millions of light years away.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Exo Planets
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer more closely and with evermore fidelity at nearby stars, they are discovering countless exo planets. How many Earth-like planets are out there? Could one of them hold life not so different from our own?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: First Light
programme.desc: The Hubble Telescope is nearing its end, the replacements are ready to go, ready to peer further back in time and space than can be imagined.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.
programme.sub-title: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it's also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Return to the Moon
programme.desc: The moon is our closest celestial companion. It lights our night sky and gently tugs at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, but her allure remains strong.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.desc: Project Mercury Begins - The start of NASA & America's first manned space program. Mars Express - The European Space Agency's Mars Satellite. The Soyuz Launch System - The gradual evolution of Russia's Soyuz launcher.
programme.sub-title: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.
programme.sub-title: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.
programme.sub-title: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.
programme.sub-title: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here
programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.
programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Audrina prøver at komme sig over Justin ved at gå efter Brody. Heidi slæber en modvillig Spencer med til parterapi. Da Stephanie kvajer sig hos People's Revolution, truer Lauren med at fyre hende.

programme.title: The Hills: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.desc: Audrina prøver at glemme Justin ved at score Brody, da pigerne tager med på drengenes surf-tur til Hawaii. Heidis uskyldige ekskæreste kommer på besøg, og hun håber, at hans værdier vil smitte af på Spencer.
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush

programme.title: The Hills: Playmates Bring the Drama
programme.desc: Audrina bliver knust, da Brodys kæreste konfronterer hende om Hawaii og Brody ikke gør noget for at stoppe det. Heidi opsnapper en sms fra Stacie til Spencer og tager på natklub for at konfrontere hende.

programme.title: The Hills: Keep Your Enemies Closer
programme.desc: Justin konfronterer Audrina om at være sammen med Brody i Hawaii. Stephanie ødelægger en fotooptagelse på jobbet, så Lauren får skældud af Kelly. Bartenderen Stacie prøver at slutte fred med Heidi.

programme.title: The Hills: Father of The Bride
programme.desc: Spencer prøver at redde sit forhold til Heidi ved at bede hendes cowboyfar om tilladelse til at gifte sig med hende. Lauren må fyre Stephanie fra People's Revolution og risikerer deres venskab.

programme.title: The Hills: Hi Lauren, It's Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren overvejer, om hun skal tage til Heidis bryllup, efter Spencer omsider siger undskyld. Brody nægter at risikere sit forhold til Jayde for at redde sit forhold til Audrina, og Stephanie konfronterer Kelly Cutrone.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Old, Something New
programme.desc: I Laurens sidste afsnit, må hun beslutte, om hun er villig til at tilgive Spencer for at kunne være der for Heidi til hendes 'prinsesse'-bryllup. Alle de medvirkende dukker op og bliver chokeret af en overraskende gæst.

programme.title: The Hills: It's On Bitch
programme.desc: Kristin starter en krig, da hun lægger an på Justin lige foran Audrina. Spencer ser på huse med Heidi og køber et hus uden hendes godkendelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.desc: Da Audrina brænder Kristin af, beslutter hun sig for ikke at kæmpe imod sin tiltrækning af Justin. Heidi melder sig til at passe naboens barn, men Spencer vil ikke have noget med børn at gøre.
programme.sub-title: Mess With Me, I Mess With You

programme.title: The Hills: Strike One
programme.desc: Kristin får sin første forsmag på at være i et forhold med Justin, da han ikke dukker op til Brodys surprise party. Heidi og Spencer er uenige om, hvornår de skal starte en familie, og Audrina går på date med Justins bedste ven.

programme.title: The Hills: Old Habits Die Hard
programme.desc: Kristin tror, at hun har tæmmet Justin, men han har måske ikke glemt Audrina. Da Holly mister kontrollen til et event, må Heidi få sin søster til at konfrontere sit spiritusproblem.

programme.title: The Hills: Sorry Boo, Strike Two
programme.desc: Justin spiller kostbar med Kristin, men hans plan giver bagslag. Hollys druk fører til en intervention af Heidi og Stephanie. Brody og Jayde skændes og genovervejer deres forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Justin er ude på dybt vand efter Kristin og Audrina endelig mødes ansigt til ansigt. Heidi vil have en baby til sin fødselsdag, men Spencer har noget andet i tankerne.

programme.title: The Hills: On To The Next
programme.desc: Kristin og Brody overvejer at date igen, men et møde med Jayde viser, det ikke er tid. Audrina og Justin mødes for at diskutere deres fremtid, men det ender ikke, som hun havde håbet. Spencer tager drastiske tiltag mod Heidis babybesættelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.desc: Kristin skændes med Jayde, fordi hun vil have Brody tilbage. Heidi planlægger at blive gravid med eller uden Spencers samtykke, Audrina må forholde sig til, at Justin stadig har følelser for Kristin.
programme.sub-title: Can't Always Get What You Want

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. Right Now
programme.desc: Kristin vil ikke være sammen med Justin, men han lader hende ikke gå uden at kæmpe. Audrina ender alt med Justin for altid. Brody får kolde fødder, da Jayde vil flytte sammen, og Spencer frygter, at Heidi måske er gravid.

programme.title: The Hills: The Boys Of Summer
programme.desc: Kristin og Justin beslutter at tage deres forhold til det næste niveau og Spencer konfronterer Heidi om en graviditetstest. Brody har måske stadig følelser for Kristin, efter Jayde konfronterer ham om deres forhold til en forlovelsesfest.

programme.title: The Hills: Put On A Happy Face
programme.desc: Heidis hjemkomst bliver ødelagt, da hendes mor kritiserer hendes plastikoperation. Kristin og pigerne tagr til Miami til Super Bowl-weekend, men stemningen bliver dårlig, da hun fester så hårdt, at det bekymrer Audrina, Lo og Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Rumor Has It
programme.desc: Da rygterne går om Kristins partying får Stephanie skylden. Audrina begynder at date en ny fyr, men det stopper ikke Brody fra at prøve at score hende. Spencer bliver vred, da han møder Stephanie til Kristins fest.

programme.title: The Hills: The Elephant In The Room
programme.desc: Heidi arrangerer en fest for sin nabo, men den bliver overskygget af at Spencer flipper ud på Holly. Kristin opfordrer Audrina til at fokusere på Ryan, og prøver derefter at få et tættere forhold til Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: This Is Goodbye
programme.desc: Heidi og Spencers opførsel fører til, at deres venner og familie træffer et vanskeligt valg. Kristin og Brody kysser, men er enige om at fortsætte som singler. Ryan skuffer Audrina, da han ikke dukker op til en bytur.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Bird
programme.desc: Brody sætter sit venskab med Kristin på spil da han begynder at date en anden pige. Lo sender Stephanie ud på en dobbeldate. Ryan giver Audrinas venner en ny chance.

programme.title: The Hills: Ghost From The Past
programme.desc: Kristin slider med at komme videre efter Brody. Audrina møder Justin og begynder at tvivle på sit forhold til Ryan. Lo bliver venner med Brodys nye kæreste.

programme.title: The Hills: The Company You Keep
programme.desc: Brodys nye flamme lægger sig ud med Kristin da hun tager en af Kristins rivalr med til en fest. Ryan kommer tilbage fra turneen, men Audrina forteæler ham ikke, at hun mødtes med Justin mens han var borte.

programme.title: The Hills: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place
programme.desc: Audrinas forhold til Ryan bliver sat på prøve, da han møder Justin for første gang. Brody er på Kristins side da Allie skændes med hende. Stephanie har en skuffende anden date.
programme.sub-title: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place

programme.title: The Hills: Break-Up to Make-Up
programme.desc: Lige da Audrina afslutter tingene med Ryan, overrasker Justin hende på hendes fødselsdag. McKaelas ven Allie skaber flere problemer for Kristin. Brody fortæller Justin hvad han tænker.

programme.title: The Hills: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: På en surfertur til Costa Rica gør Kristin Brody jaloux ved at kysse med en lokal bartender, Audrina prøver at modstå den tiltrækning, hun føler til Justin, og Stephanie har det svæt i junglen.

programme.title: The Hills: Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Kristin har en åbenhjertig samtale med Brody fordi hun ønsker at give forholdet en ny chance. Heidis mor kommer til LA, i håbet om at de kan forsones. Lo og hendes kæreste fejrer jubilæum og Stephanie begynder at date en ny fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: All Good Things...
programme.desc: Kristin står overfor en vigtig beslutning, som også påvirker Brody. Audrina slår op med Justin. Lo ved ikke, om hun er klar til at tage det næste skridt med sin kæreste og Stephanie tror, at hun endelig har fundet lykken.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Hold Grudges... JK!
programme.desc: Den ikoniske vennegruppe begynder på en frisk, da de vender tilbage til The Hills og ses for første gang i flere år. Der er nye udfordringer, gamle rivaliseringer og romantiske forviklinger da de indser, at fortiden ikke altid er fortiden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Not My Family
programme.desc: Stephanie prøver at reparere sit forhold til sin bror, Spencer, Mischa konfronterer Perez Hilton, der mobbede hende før i tiden. Gnisten mellem Audrina og Justin ulmer stadig, men Justin har også fået øje på en anden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: A Legend in His Own Mind
programme.desc: Audrina får en chokerende oplysning om Justin Bobby, der tvinger hende til at genoverveje sine motiver. Bølgerne går højt, da Spencer og Heidi overvejer deres forhold til Brody. Og Brandon Thomas holder et poolparty for sin mor.
programme.sub-title: A Legend in His Own Mind

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop
programme.desc: Audrina konfronterer Justin efter han nægter at have kysset hende. Brody klager over forholdet til sin far, Caitlyn og hans tidligere bedste ven Spencer. Da de forsøger at udvide forretningen, bliver Spencer og Heidees forhold sat på en prøve.
programme.sub-title: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Gruppen tager til Vegas for at se Brody optræde som dj, og Justin føler sig fanget mellem Audrina og Stephanie. Der udbryder naturbrande i Malibu og Kaitlyn frygter for Brodys liv, da han bliver i evakueringszonen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends
programme.desc: Brody og Kaitlynn skal forholde sig til naturbranden i Malibu. Audrina træffer en svær beslutning om Justin. Mischa skal til audition til en stor filmrolle og Heidi vil genoplive sin popsangerinde-karriere.
programme.sub-title: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Enemy #1
programme.desc: Rygterne flyver efter en skadaløs hændelse, der involverer Brody og Stephanie. Audrina får et chok, da Justin tager en flot date med til middagen.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Queen Has Arrived
programme.desc: Det går skævt mellem David og Lateysha,. da realitydronningen Tiffany Pollard ankommer og afslører Davids sande følelser over for Lateysha. To ekser forlader villaen for evigt.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Battle of the Divas
programme.desc: Bølgerne går højt, da Victoria er splittet mellem Michael og en ny deltager. Lateysha eksploderer, da Marissa flirter med David, og Joey opfører et romantisk rap for Lorena.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Heartbreak
programme.desc: Den mest dramatiske og følelsesladede ankomst giver Lorena hjertesorger, men er det slut for JOLO. Michael betror sig til Ellie, men kan han lægge Victoria bag sig?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Joeys usikkerhed får bugt med ham, da Lorena vil lave sød musik med Patrick. David undskylder endelig over for Lateysha, og der er en dobbelt chok-ankomst på stranden.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Calum's Choice
programme.desc: Calumm skal sende en af sine ekser hjem. Georgia bliver følelsesladet med Ashley, Michael og Ellie kommer tættere på hinanden og der er en surprise-kendis i horisonten.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Miles and the Mob Wife
programme.desc: Miles, den nye kendis, gør et stort indtryk på Marissa. David får skældud og piger skal træffe en vigtig beslutning.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: As One Door Closes Another One Opens
programme.desc: En af drengene bliver sendt hjem, og det efterlader pigerne med tårer i øjnene. Det bliver for meget for en af de originale 8, og Sophie har muligvis mødt sin drømmemand. Får David en chance til?
programme.sub-title: As One Door Closes Another One Opens

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Mob Wife Goes In
programme.desc: Georgia og Miles kommer tættere på hinanden, men ender det i tårer? Marissa bliver presset til sin 'mafiakone'-grænse og Joey og Lorena tager ned på stranden til den sidste ankomst!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Finale
programme.desc: Joey får sit livs chok, da en eks gør en spektakulær entré til den store finale, og Georgia bliver følelsesladet, men får hun sin lykkelige slutning med de andre par?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Zahida Wages War
programme.desc: Otte sexede singler opdager, at deres drøm om sommerkærlighed bliver et mareridt, når flere ekser end nogensinder kommer for at skabe kaos. Zahida kæmper med Maisie om Sean, men når den første eks kommer, bliver det et værre blodbad.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: A Sea Of Tears
programme.desc: Det syder i villaen, når ikke bare en, men tre ekser ankommer og skaber kaos for turtelduerne Ross og Harriette. Zahidas eks Joe mister kontrollen, og Alex truer med at drukne sig i tårer.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Harriette's Love Triangle
programme.desc: Singlernes elendighed fortsætter, da Sean springer fra Zahida til Zaralena, og Harriettes kærlighedstrekant bliver værre. Maisie vil have, der skal ske noget, og Aaron fra 'Geordie Shore' gør en storslået entré, men hvem af ekserne er hans?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Nicole's Nightmare
programme.desc: Spændingerne i villaen når kogepunktet, da Zaralena får Zahidas vrede at føle. Den nye eks får fyrene til at føre sig territorialt. Josh har et godt øje til Nicole, men slutter det, da hun opdager en knusende hemmelighed?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Blonde Bombshell
programme.desc: Adam afslører sine følelser for Nicole, og Jack og Josh vil have nyt blod i villaen. Zaralena og Aaron kommer tættere på hinanden, og Ross og Harriette tilbringer natten i loftslejligheden. Men en ny eks kan ødelægge det for alle.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Harriette's Heartache
programme.desc: Terrortabletten gør livet surt for Becca. Harriettes hjertesorg bliver værre, og Zaralenas elendighed fortsætter, men det er den nyeste eks, der truer med at skabe det værste kaos.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Truth Comes Out
programme.desc: Ankomsten af endnu en eks fører til et blodbad i villaen. Nicole må høre sandheden om Jacques Fraser, mens Ross og Harriette skændes igen. Og Zaralena tager en stor beslutning.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Jacques Comeuppance
programme.desc: Jacques Fraser får omsider sin straf. Det nyeste ekser stormer stranden og villaen, skaber splid mellem Sean og Zahida og skaber kaos for resten.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Aaron Moves On
programme.desc: Der kommer to nye ekser, til Aarons glæde og Beccas fortvivlelse. Maisie når bunden, Harriette får et sammenbrud og Sean og Jack kommer ryger i totterne på hinanden.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Big Fat Greek Wedding
programme.desc: Terrortabletten holder et stort græsk bryllup for Sean og Zahida, men da den sidste eks kommer, bliver festen kaotisk. Harriette får en chokerende besked af Ross.

programme.desc: Otte lækre og kærlighedshungrende kendte mødes i deres nye villa. Kori ser et kendt ansigt, mens Mike tager sin kendte med på date. Men der er endnu en overraskelse, før den første eks vækker dybe følelser.

programme.desc: Huset er chokeret efter sidste parceremoni. Jenni mener, at Layton er hendes rette fyr, men frygter at en knust Jessica bliver vred. For et par truer sandhedsbåsen med at bringe mere hjertesorg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Parental Guidance
programme.desc: Pigerne får overraskende informationer, når deres forældre kommer for at udspørge fyrene. Når forældrene rejser, eksploderer spændingerne mellem Layton og Anthony. Huset finder ud af, at historien kan gentage sig.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Hot Salsa
programme.desc: Efter en mislykket parceremoni er huset klar til en ny start. John mener endelig at have fundet den rette i Jenni, men de andre i huset er ikke så sikre. Ashley befinder sig i et potentielt eksplosivt trekantsdrama.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Dumped
programme.desc: Kampen mellem Dario og Layton over Ashley strammer til. Ellie vender sin opmærksomhed mod Nathan, som er overbevist om, at Christina er hans perfekte partner. For Christina bliver presset med at være pige nummer 11 for meget.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Old Flames
programme.desc: Selvom de ikke er et par, eksploderer Nathan, når Christina går tilbage til Brandon. Med to parceremonier tilbage, kunne Ashleys ubeslutsomhed mellem Layton og Dario afholde huset fra at vinde det hele.

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Switch, One Glitch
programme.desc: Det er den sidste parceremoni og de skal udskifte et par. Mens sandhedsbåsen giver et tiltrængt svar, bringer spørgsmålet om pige nummer 11 millionen i fare.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Season Aftermatch
programme.desc: Hele sæsonens hemmeligheder, drama og uafklarede affærer kommer frem i lyset i dette genforeningsafsnit, hvor de medvirkende skiftes til at sidde i den varme stol.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Perfect Match at First Sight
programme.desc: 20 singler ankommer til Hawaii for at finde kærlighed og vinde 1 million dollar. Deres kærlighed ved første blik-instinkter bliver sat på prøve med 250.000 ekstra på spil. En kærlighedstrekant fører til en pinlig parceremoni.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Punch Drunk Love
programme.desc: John eksploderer, når forholdet til Julia forandrer sig. Asaf og Francesca ved ikke, hvor de står, da en tur til bolleværelset kikser. Kaylen slipper en bombe om sit forhold til Gio, som chokerer huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: She Don't Want You
programme.desc: John flipper skråt, da Stephen bager på Julia. Tori og Camille er begge ude efter den samme fyr. Presset er stort for de 'gyldne par' som skal i sandhedsbåsen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Huset er i oprør, da Gio og Kaylens perfekte forhold begynder at slå revner. Asaf går i seng med den forkerte person.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Beer Goggles
programme.desc: Forholdet mellem Gio og Kaylen får alle op på dupperne, da Gio bager på Julia og alle andre piger i huset. Cam og Victoria har en nat, der ikke er værd at huske.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Mammas' Boys
programme.desc: Fyrene viser deres bløde siger, når deres mødre afslører pinlige detaljer. Stephen bliver ekstremt paranoid på grund af Gios intresse for Julia. Francesca bliver fanget i Gios klør.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Pulling Punches
programme.desc: En fest med Adam og Eva-tema fører til jalousi, når parrene blandes. En kærlighedstrekant tager form, og der bliver ballade, når John, Tyler, Stephen og Gio prøver at forstå deres forvirrede hjerter.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Great Ex-pectations
programme.desc: En pinlig udfordring får ekserne til at begynde at sprede rygter. Gio og Stephen får endelig sandheden at vide om Julia.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Third Eye Blind
programme.desc: Gamle konflikter kommer op til overfladen og et stort skænderi fører til chok og tårer. Med kun to parceremonier tilbage prøver deltagerne desperat at lave en strategi for at vinde.

programme.title: Are You The One?: All or Nothing
programme.desc: Det er alt eller intet, da den tiende og sidste parceremoni nærmer sig. Strategien fører gruppen til at tro på visse par, men Asaf er splittet mellem at følge sit hjerte eller sit team.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Swipe Right for Love
programme.desc: 22 singler flytter ind i et hus i New Orleans og prøver at sætte 11 perfekte par sammen for at vinde en million dollar. Par falder pladask for hinanden og kærlighedstrekanter dannes.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Shot Through the Heart
programme.desc: Malcoms opfører sig som en rigtig player og kommer i klemme mellem Diandra og Nurys. Keith og Alexis prøver at knuse hinandens hjerter ved at date andre.

programme.title: MTV Teen Mom
programme.desc: Oplev de dramatiske øjeblikke, når de unge mødre tackler hverdagens udfordringer eller oplever uforglemmelige øjeblikke. Det er non-stop drama hele dagen, hver dag.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.
programme.sub-title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.
programme.sub-title: My Love is a Black Heart

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.
programme.sub-title: What Comes First: Sex or Love?

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna har svært ved at rede trådene ud i sit forskruede kærlighedsliv efter brud og genforeninger med drengene - lige indtil en uventet tekst placerer hendes dramatiske liv lige midt i rampelyset.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Efter Jennas udgivelse af sin blog har alle pludselig en mening om hendes liv. Mens alle andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, kræver Jake og Matty svar.
programme.sub-title: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me

programme.title: Awkward: Once Upon a Blog
programme.desc: Jennas fantasi løber af med hende, og hun omdanner sin blog til en fiktiv fortælling i et forsøg på at ændre sin skæbne. Ved at undersøge og forestille sig en anden udgave af sin fortid forsøger Jenna at gennemskue fremtiden.

programme.title: Awkward: The Other Shoe
programme.desc: Jennas beslutning om drengene når ud til alle. Læg dertil en tur til Europa, og alt ser ud til at gå godt for Jenna. Der sker imidlertid noget, der får Jenna til at betvivle, om det at få alt det, hun ønsker, er det, hun har brug for.

programme.title: Awkward: Cha-Cha-Cha-Changes
programme.desc: Tredje år på high school byder på overraskelser og forandringer, der kan ændre hele Jennas fremtid.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekammerats død får Jenna til at tænke over tab og sorg, og hun tager ansvar for den hemmelighed, hun skjuler fra Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: A Little Less Conversation
programme.desc: Matty virker fjern, da han hører, at Jenna tror, hun er gravid, men Jenna vil næsten gøre alt for ikke at tage 'snakken'.

programme.title: Awkward: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: Jennas far gør selv noget ved sagen og taler med Mattys forældre om deres børns forhold.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: Da Matty flytter ind hos Hamiltons indser Jenna, at hun har fået mere med i købet end hun havde håbet på.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøgelserne fra Jennas fortid, og Jennas egen usikkerhed, melder sig på banen da det bliver Halloween i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jenna's første date til Homecoming-festen vækker skyldige minder om den pige, hun plejede at være og om de piger, der ikke har en date.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En udfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til at blotte sig selv se nogle svære afsløringer om sig selv i øjnene.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest så hendes venner kan vænne sig til tanken om hendes og Collins spirende forhold. Men da deres støtte udebliver, tager hun drastiske midler i brug.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet uvenner med Tamara og Ming, synes Jenna ikke at det spiller nogen rolle hvad hun gør længere - og det kaster hende ud i en vanskelig situation.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.
programme.sub-title: A Very Special Episode of Awkward

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?

programme.title: Awkward: Old Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håber, at hvis hun retter op på sine fejl ved at hjælpe Val med at få sit job tilbage, vil universet belønne hende med at sørge for, at hun og Matty finder sammen igen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna bliver udfordret til at sætte spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem hun vil være i den episke sæsonfinale.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: Pinlige øjeblikke venter, når vi tager et kig på de bedste klip fra 'Awkward', hvor skuespillerne selv kommenterer de sjoveste replikker, de saftigste forhold og meget mere fra deres yndlingsafsnit af 'Awkward'.

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs
programme.desc: En række pranks skaber kaos og Jennas forsæt om at holde op med at tænke på Matty bliver sat på prøve, da hun overhører en chokerende hemmelighed.

programme.title: Awkward: Short Circuit Party
programme.desc: Jenna er skyld i en ulykke på skolen, som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvenserne af konfrontationen med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna In Wonderland
programme.desc: Mens Jenna nyder lidt popularitet, har Matty det svært med at blive holdt uden for. Samtidig bager Jake på den nye pige, og Ally holder en sexlege-fest.

programme.title: Awkward: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
programme.desc: Årbøgerne er kommet ud. Jenna bliver helt nede over stikordet under hendes billede, men hvad vil Matty skrive i hendes årbog?
programme.sub-title: Now You See Me, Now I Don't

programme.title: Awkward: The Dis-Engagement Dinner
programme.desc: Jenna tvinges til at holde en fest for Tamara for at fejre hendes falske forlovelse. Samtidig får Jenna en hemmelighed at vide om Matty, der sender hende ud på en jagt efter sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Don't Dream It's Over
programme.desc: Da Tamara siger, at Jenna ødelægger forhold, konfronterer Jenna sine ekskærester med overraskende resultater.

programme.title: Awkward: The Big Reveal
programme.desc: Jenna vil afsløre sandheden for Matty, men vil hendes nærmeste stoppe hende?

programme.title: Up In The Air
programme.desc: Ryan Bingham lever et højtsvævende liv. Han flyver over hele verden på forretningsrejser og er stadig på farten. Men så møder han medpassageren Alex og lærer, at livet ikke handler om rejsen, men om kontakterne man får på vejen.

programme.title: White Oleander
programme.desc: I et anfald af sygelig jalousi forgifter den kompromisløse og forførende kunstner, Ingrid, sin kæreste. Hun idømmes livsvarigt fængsel og hendes 15-årige datter, Astrid, bliver derefter kastet rundt mellem forskellige plejefamilier.

programme.title: Weird: The Al Yankovic Story
programme.desc: Filmen skildrer Yankovics liv fra hans lynhurtige vej til berømmelse med tidlige hits som ”Eat It” og ”Like a Surgeon” til hans lidenskabelige kærlighedsforhold og lastefulde livsstil.

programme.title: Lars and The Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars Lindstrom er en elskelig indadvendt mand, hvis emotionelle bagage har afholdt ham fra at udforske livet. Efter flere års ensomhed inviterer han Bianca, en ven han har mødt på internettet. Han introducerer Bianca for sin bror, Gus og hans kone, Karen.

programme.title: Youth In Revolt
programme.desc: På en ferie møder den kiksede teenager Nick Twisp drømmepigen Sheeni. Nick, der ikke tidligere har haft held med piger, vil gøre alt for at vinde hendes hjerte og opfinder et alter-ego, den flamboyante og dristige Francois Dillinger.

programme.title: 10 Things we should do before we break up
programme.desc: Den aften, hvor Abigail, en enlig mor til to små børn, møder Ben på en bar, finder de for sjov på en liste over ting, de skal gøre, inden deres tænkte brud med hinanden, selv om de ved, at de aldrig vil indlede et forhold.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: Chers verden går op i limningen med den pludselige tilstedeværelse af to lækre fyre i hendes liv: en sexet, ny klassekammerat og hendes kedelige men søde eks-stedbror. Hun lærer nu, at når det handler om kærlighed, så ved hun ingenting.

programme.title: Elizabethtown
programme.desc: Drew Baylor, en populær designer, hvis verden styrter sammen på én uheldssvanger dag. På vej hjem til Elizabethtown møder Drew Claire. Hun er smuk, og hun er fast besluttet på at blive den pige, der hjælper og vejleder Drew på rejsen hjem.

programme.title: The Place Beyond the Pines
programme.desc: En stuntkører overvejer at begå en forbrydelse for at forsørge sin familie, hvilket bringer ham på kollisionskurs med en politiker, der engang var politimand. Et krimidrama om det ubrydelige bånd mellem fædre og sønner.

programme.title: The Whistleblower
programme.desc: The Whistleblower' er en stærk og autentisk thriller, der stiller skarpt på en af de allerstørste skandaler i FNs historie.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Secrets
programme.desc: Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Global Pursuit
programme.desc: In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: An armed robbery is a terrifying ordeal. When a gang descended on a Los Angeles cash vault, they threatened to kill anyone who resisted. The violent assault was the largest heist in U.S. history and a piece of plastic was the only evidence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A criminal who kills a police officer wages war on society. In 1987 such a criminal vanished after shooting two Boston officers, one fatally. He had a history of violence against cops and the protection of a group of outlaws.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When a bank teller arrived at her parent's home the gunmen were already there. The robbers held her family hostage and forced her to empty a bank vault. If she didn't comply she could lose everyone she loved.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: While camping with her family in Montana, a seven-year-old girl was abducted from her tent. No one in the campground witnessed the crime and the kidnapper left no clues.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenaged boy disappeared. Because they vanished within hours of each other, police believed the cases were linked. But they didn't know how.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Unlawful Flight
programme.desc: In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.

programme.title: Hercules in New York
programme.desc: Hercules (Arnold Schwarzenegger) er forvist fra Mount Olympus og sendes til Jorden, hvor han finder ægte kærlighed og starter en lovende karriere i bodybuilder-branchen.

programme.title: Sidste Chance
programme.desc: En falsk anklaget mand må forsøge at overleve en offentlig henrettelse iscenesat som et gameshow på TV.

programme.title: Copycat
programme.desc: En detektiv fra San Francisco får hjælp fra en uvillig retsmedicinsk psykolog for at finde en seriemorder.

programme.title: Can You Keep a Secret?
programme.desc: I den tro at de er ved at styrte ned, fortæller Emma alle sine hemmeligheder til en flot, men vildfremmed mand om bord på et fly. Det vil sige, hun troede, at han var fremmed… Filmen er baseret på bestsellerromanen af samme navn fra Sophie Kinsella.

programme.title: Frankie & Johnny
programme.desc: Pfeiffer spiller Frankie, der arbejder som servitrice på en kaffebar i New York. Efter flere smertelige forhold er det sidste Frankie søger en ny mand...indtil han opsøger hende.

programme.title: Broken English
programme.desc: Nora Wilder er ved at miste håbet. Alle i hendes nærhed er i et forhold, er gifte eller har børn. Nora er i 30-årsalderen, alene med et arbejde hun ikke trives med, og en mor der konstant babler løs.

programme.title: Angreb! Er det bedste forsvar
programme.desc: To snobbede millionærer fra Rio de Janeiro bliver udsat for pengeafpresning. Heldigvis møder de Elliott Vance (Terence Hill) og Greg Wonder (Bud Spencer), som ligner dem på en prik, og de hyrer dem for en tid som stand-ins.

programme.title: Med Røven I Vandskorpen
programme.desc: Bill Murray spiller hovedrollen som Tripper Harrison, lejrchefen på Camp North Star. Der er masser af sjov og ballade i vente, mens han sammen med lejrens øvrige ledere gør, hvad han kan for at bryde alle regler.

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: Tre mænd genoplever deres sorgløse collegetid ved at dræbe så mange hjerneceller, de kan, i denne forskruede komedie. Mitch kommer hjem fra en mindre behagelig forretningsrejse og afslører sin kone Heidi midt i en trekant.

programme.title: Waiting . . .
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds, Anna Ferris og Justin Long serverer grinene som unge tjenere og servitricer, der søger en mening med livet, kærligheden og venskabet i denne forrygende komedie.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Da en klog sort hustler fra South Central i Los Angeles bliver transporteret tilbage til middelalderens England, leder han omstyrtelsen af en ond konge og vinder en protofeministisk kvindes hjerte.

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Stanley Crawford (Colin Firth) er tryllekunstner, men skeptisk overfor det overnaturlige. Han møder den clairvoyante Sophie Baker (Emma Stone) og skal afsløre hendes tricks, men kan ikke finde nogen. Er der mon mere mellem himmel og jord?

programme.title: Tommy Boy
programme.desc: Tommy har fået sit diplom og et job hos Callahan Auto Parts. Men familieforetagendet begynder at gå nedad bakke, og Tommy kører af sted med sin fars højre hånd, en dumsmart talknuser.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders

programme.title: Unsolved Murders

programme.title: South Park: F-ordet
programme.desc: Drengene konfronterer en gruppe irriterende bikers, men deres metoder får byens folk til at redefinere betydningen af et skældsord.

programme.title: South Park: frække ninjaer
programme.desc: Indbyggerne i South Park beslutter sig for, at de ikke længere behøver en politistyrke.

programme.title: South Park: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: Stans far bliver arresteret for spritkørsel. Samtidig tiltrækker en blødende madonnastatue i nabobyen alle mulige mislykkede eksistenser, som håber på helbredelse.

programme.title: South Park: Døden
programme.desc: Stans gamle bedstefar forsøger at narre drengene til at slå ham ihjel. I mellemtiden forsøger South Parks forældre at overtale et tv-netværk til at befri luftrummet for Terrance og Philip.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans dumme hatecrime 2000
programme.desc: FBI indleder en undersøgelse af Cartmans hatecrime, efter at han har kastet en sten efter Token.

programme.title: South Park: Regnskov dropskov
programme.desc: Drengene bliver sendt til regnskoven i Costa Rica som led i en turné med koret Getting Gay With Kids.

programme.title: South Park: Du er ved at blive gammel
programme.desc: Da Stan får en Tween Wave CD i fødselsdagsgave forbyder hans forældre at lytte til sådan noget 'lort'. Stan kan kun være enige med dem, hvilket ikke ligefrem imponerer hans venner.
programme.sub-title: Du er ved at blive gammel

programme.title: South Park: Den magiske busk
programme.desc: Cartman og Butters får fat i en drone og tager på en flyvetur rundt i kvarteret.

programme.title: South Park: 'Snuke'
programme.desc: Indbyggerne i South Park lader op til Hillary Clintons ankomst. Cartman har mistanke om, at en ny muslimsk elev er involveret i et muligt terrorangreb.

programme.title: South Park: Medlemsbær
programme.desc: I premiereafsnittet til sæson 20 bliver nationalsangen genopfrisket af et amerikansk ikon.

programme.title: South Park: Sarkastabold
programme.desc: Randy kommer med en sarkastisk bemærkning om, at det er for farligt for børn at spille football. Det er startskuddet til en national sport der involverer bh'er og en ballon.

programme.title: South Park: #REHASH
programme.desc: Kyle vil bare spille tv-spil med sin lillebror. Men når Ike ikke vil spille med ham mere, er Kyle bange for, at den næste generation forbigår ham.

programme.title: South Park: Feriespecial
programme.desc: Et ubestrideligt bånd knyttes mellem en hvid mand og en indianer.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman får en anal sondeundersøgelse
programme.desc: Cartman drømmer, at han har et nærgående møde med et rumvæsen. De andre drenge er overbeviste om, at drømmen var virkelig, og at han har været offer for en anal sondeundersøgelse af et rumvæsen.

programme.title: South Park: Butterballs
programme.desc: Butters bliver mobbet af sin bedstemor, og Stan vil skabe opmærksomhed om problemet ved at indspille en video, men dens succes stiger ham snart til hovedet.

programme.title: South Park: Timmy 2000
programme.desc: Drengene efterligner Timmy, som har ADHD, for st slippe for lektierne.

programme.title: South Park: Fru lærer kysser på en dreng
programme.desc: Cartmann er den nye præfekt og finder ud af, at en lærer har kysset en elev på hans område.
programme.sub-title: Fru lærer kysser på en dreng

programme.title: South Park: VACCINATIONER!!!
programme.desc: Randy fejrer Tegridys succes, og Cartman nægter at blive vaccineret.

programme.title: South Park: Coon
programme.desc: Om dagen er Eric Cartman, en fed dreng i 4. klasse. Om aftenen er han The Coon, en fed selvtægtsmand, der er klædt ud som vaskebjørn og vildt opmærksomhedssøgende.

programme.title: South Park: Den nye Terrance og Phillip-trailer
programme.desc: Alle børnene i South Park er superspændte på at se den første trailer for den nye Terrance og Phillip-film.

programme.title: South Park: Glutenfri ebola
programme.desc: South Park bliver glutenfrit.

programme.title: South Park: Julesne
programme.desc: Julemanden stjæler al byens juleglæde.

programme.title: South Park: Usikkerhed
programme.desc: Cartman anskaffer sig et nyt sikringssystem til hjemmet.

programme.title: South Park: Dumme forkælede luder-video-legetøj
programme.desc: Paris Hilton åbner en butik i South Park og fordærver moralen blandt byens piger. Kun Wendy holder fast i den gamle moral.

programme.title: South Park: Hot katolsk kærlighed
programme.desc: Præst Maxi rejser til Rom, da skandalen i den katolske kirke truer med at påvirke antallet af kirkegængere i South Park negativt.

programme.title: South Park: Stanleys Cup
programme.desc: Stan bliver træner for Pee Wee Hockey-holdet og prøver at gøre dem til et vinderhold.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Kyle, Cartman og Kenny biver fanget af den nyeste dille fra Japan, Chinpokomon.

programme.title: South Park: Pragtsvinet og Bæ
programme.desc: Da PETA ødelægger South Parks maskot, splitter diskussionen om en erstatning skolen. Stan trues af P Diddy og bortvises fra byen for at at nægte at stemme.

programme.title: South Park: Help, My Teenager Hates Me!
programme.desc: Drengene finder ud af, at med glæden ved at spille Airsoft, følger udfordringen at skulle forholde sig til teenagere.

programme.title: South Park: Informativ mordporno
programme.desc: Drengene bruger spillet Minecraft til at forhindre sine forældre I at skade hinanden.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasiland del 1
programme.desc: Drengene befinder sig i et magisk land, hvor hele verdens fantasi ligger lige foran dem. Men en terrorplan truer med at ødelægge det hele.

programme.title: South Park: Den mexicanske glofrø fra det sydlige Sri Lanka

programme.sub-title: Den mexicanske glofrø fra det sydlige Sri Lanka

programme.title: South Park: Her kommer kvarteret
programme.desc: Som det eneste rige barn i byen, føler Token sig som et udskud, og detlykkes ham at tiltrække adskillige andre velhavende folk til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Rødtotter
programme.desc: Cartman lider af et tilfælde af 'Gingervitus' og tager kampen op mod forfølgelsen af hans rødhårede fæller.

programme.title: South Park: Goth Kids 3: Posørernes dag
programme.desc: Goth-ungerne sendes på en lejr for problembørn.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle bliver uvenner over en magisk trekant, som dukker op på en arkæologisk udgravning. Trekanten giver magt til at forandre Barbra Streisand til et forfærdeligt monster.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasiland del 3
programme.desc: Stan og Butters er strandet i Imaginationland og må kæmpe for livet mod en hær af onde kræfter. Kyle og Cartman er stadig i Pentagon.

programme.desc: Korra's three-year journey of healing takes her to unexpected places.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Coronation
programme.desc: Prince Wu's big day is ruined by Kuvira; Korra thinks she may have found the key to a full recovery.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Calling

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Enemy at the Gates
programme.desc: Kuvira threatens Zaofu; Bolin is caught in the middle of the bad blood between Su Beifong and Kuvira.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Battle of Zaofu
programme.desc: Korra returns to her role as the Avatar, but is she really ready for action? Bolin and Varrick break from Kuvira's army.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Reunion
programme.desc: Korra returns to Republic City and Team Avatar faces their first mission together in three years when Prince Wu goes missing; Bolin and Varrick are on the lam.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Remembrances
programme.desc: A look back at Team Avatar's journey; Varrick tells the story of the greatest move ever made.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Beyond the Wilds
programme.desc: The spirit vines in Republic City start abducting people and it's up to Korra to figure out why.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Operation Beifong
programme.desc: Bolin helps Opal and Lin save the Beifongs from Kuvira; Korra visits the Spirit World looking for help.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Kuvira's Gambit
programme.desc: Korra and Team Avatar try to stop Kuvira from moving against Republic City; Kuvira unveils a deadly new weapon.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Day of the Colossus
programme.desc: Team Avatar clashes with Kuvira on the streets of Republic City; Pema and Prince Wu help evacuate innocent citizens.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Last Stand
programme.desc: The fate of the Earth Kingdom and the Avatar's life is at stake, when Korra comes face to face with Kuvira.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boy in the Iceberg
programme.desc: When a young waterbender, named Katara, and her brother, Sokka, discover a giant iceberg while fishing for food around their homestead at the South Pole, they discover that there is a boy, named Aang, inside.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Avatar Returns
programme.desc: After Aang accidentally sets off a Fire Nation trap, he is banished from the South Pole. Soon after Prince Zuko attacks the Southern Water Tribe seeking to capture the Avatar. Aang returns and surrenders to save the Water Tribe.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Southern Air Temple
programme.desc: Aang is eager to take Sokka and Katara to the Air Temple where he was raised. But upon arrival, it becomes apparent that the temple is not at all how Aang remembers it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Warriors of Kyoshi
programme.desc: As one of Aang's little detours, the group heads toward the island of Kyoshi. But soon they learn that the townspeople don't trust foreigners at all; however, when Aang proves to them that he is the Avatar they are treated as guests of honor.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The King of Omashu
programme.desc: Aang takes Katara and Sokka back to a favorite place he used to go to when he was younger, the Earth Kingdom City of Omashu. But when they break the law they are taken to the King to get their punishment.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Imprisoned
programme.desc: The kids come to an Earth Nation town which is occupied by the Fire Nation. But will Katara's attempts to inspire the oppressed people help them or hurt them?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Winter Solstice Part 1: The Spirit World

programme.sub-title: Winter Solstice Part 1: The Spirit World

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Winter Solstice Part 2: Avatar Roku

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Waterbending Scroll
programme.desc: After Katara attempts to teach Aang waterbending, she is desperate to improve her abilities.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Jet

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg møder Fred
programme.desc: Freddie siger offentligt, at han ikke er en fan af internetsensationen Fred, og får Fred til at meddele, at han holder op med at lave sine videoer. Hans fans bliver rasende over, at Freddie fik stoppet de populære videoer.

programme.title: iCarly: Et perfekt match

programme.title: iCarly: Vi valgte vinderen
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Freddie opfordrer iCarly-fans til at stemme på David Archuleta i Amerika Synger, får de ondt af nummer to og hjælper ham med at lave en musikvideo.

programme.title: iCarly: En sødere Sam
programme.desc: Da Sam indrømmer, at hun kan lide en dreng i skolen, lærer Carly hende, hvordan hun besnærer ham ved at opføre sig mere piget. Spencer er overbevist om, at en pige kan lide ham pga. hans smoking, så han går med den hele tiden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg dater en forbryder Del 1

programme.title: iCarly: Gensyn med Missy
programme.desc: Da Carlys gamle veninde Missy flytter tilbage til Seattle, tror Sam, at Missy prøver at udskifte hende som Carlys bedste veninde.

programme.title: iCarly: Mesterskabet
